kind: real office building (LBNL Building 59, 4 RTUs, ~50 zones)

symbolization.rule: total confirmation bits with faithfulness and noise floors (METHOD 3.2, v1)

source: LBNL Building 59 (Luo et al. 2022, Scientific Data; doi:10.7941/D1N33Q, CC0; mirrored at Zenodo 5951008)
span_note: calendar year 2019 of a 2018-2020 record, 5-minute means; CO2 from 2019-08-19; RTU and zone points at 1 min, setpoints 5 min, weather and meters 15 min (interpolated)
entity_note: candidates unit (every zone and RTU a unit) and zone (RTU points system-wide); a single-system layout (299 roles, ~1,800 types) is not fittable by the Markov-only comparison and was not run
tags_note: parts of speech (3.14): clock prefix at 5-minute means relative to H; place prefix from the v1 library; dimension suffix from the point units (°F temperatures <Θ>, cfm flows, in. w.c. pressures, % positions and speeds, kW, W/m²)
